title: Shared item judgments
description: The judgments of one batch of shared items (atw-matrix shared-items --batches): for each item two or more Epics need whose architecture is not approved, the Epic that goes first on it and why, decided from the Epics' requirements. `atw-matrix record-judgments --file <path>` records every judgment of the file as the one architecture-side drives relationship from that Epic to the item, with its basis and reason, or records none when one is refused; a judgment by another Epic recorded earlier for the item is replaced. scripts/portfolio/epicorder.py then makes every other Epic that needs the item wait for that Epic.

item.description: The id of the shared item: a feature, or a service, component, infrastructure, event, stack, package or layer entry.

driver.description: The beads id of the Epic that goes first: one of the Epics that need the item.

basis.description: owns: this Epic builds and owns the item, and the other Epics use it. shared: the Epics share the item independently (as two Epics whose Lambdas both need the VPC), and this Epic merely goes first.

reason.description: Why, in one sentence, from the Epics' requirements.
